tempoPlot

Microbiome Time Series Visualization

The scope of this package is the visualization of longitudinal microbiome data. Plots use results computed with miaTime and mia, and the main classes for interfacing are TreeSummarizedExperiment and MultiAssayExperiment.

Installation 

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("0xMuluh/tempoPlot")

Example

miaTime computes a longitudinal quantity and stores it in the object; tempoPlot plots it.

library(tempoPlot)
data("minimalgut", package = "miaTime")

# Bray-Curtis dissimilarity of each sample from the previous one
tse <- miaTime::addStepwiseDivergence(minimalgut,
    group = "StudyIdentifier", time.col = "Time.hr",
    assay.type = "counts")

events <- data.frame(start = c(0, 152), end = c(24, NA),
    label = c("batch", "Blautia added"))
plotTrend(tse, y = "divergence", time.col = "Time.hr",
    group = "StudyIdentifier", group.by = "StudyIdentifier",
    events = events)

The figure has one line per bioreactor: the dissimilarity of each sample from the previous one over the 460 h run, between about 0.1 and 1. The batch phase is shaded, and a vertical line marks the addition of Blautia hydrogenotrophica at 152 h. The first sample of each bioreactor has no previous sample and is left out.

The vignette, vignette("tempoPlot"), follows a full analysis of a human cohort and of the bioreactors.

Which function for which question

Question Function
When were samples taken? plotSwimmer()
plotGaps()
plotCalendar()
How does a value change over time? plotTrend()
plotTimeEffect()
plotIntervals()
How does the composition change? plotComposition()
plotTiles()
plotHorizon()
plotRanks()
How fast and how much do communities change? plotTurnover()
plotTBI()
plotLagProfile()
plotRecurrence()
plotIndividuality()
plotFingerprint()
plotDOC()
Are there states and rhythms? plotTransitionMatrix()
plotAlluvial()
plotSurvival()
plotLandscape()
plotSpectrum()
plotLagHeatmap()
Which features or subjects stand out? plotStats()
plotVolcano()
plotFeatureScatter()
plotSubjectScatter()
plotTimeLoadings()
How do subjects move in ordinations and networks? plotPath()
plotDirection()
plotProcrustes()
plotNetwork()
